text: Setting clear goals is the first step to a successful project. Many teams use the SMART method to define them. This means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. After setting the main goal, you should break it down into smaller milestones. These are key checkpoints that help you track progress and stay on schedule. Each milestone leads to a concrete deliverable, such as a report or a prototype. Finally, it is essential to ensure stakeholder alignment. This means everyone involved, from the team to the client, agrees on the objectives and expectations before work begins. This prevents misunderstandings later and keeps the project focused.
